description:
A company's fundamentals from its SEC filings (10-Q/10-K): market cap, P/E, price/sales, dividend yield,
12-month revenue and net income with year-over-year growth (growing / flat / declining, accelerating or slowing),
margins, free cash flow, cash, debt, cash runway, stock-based pay, and a quarter-by-quarter table of revenue,
net income and EPS with YoY change for each quarter. Use for 'is revenue growing?', 'what's the P/E?',
'does it pay a dividend?', 'is it profitable?', 'show the last 8 quarters'.
name: get_financials
